keyPointsEn: RSI and MACD lack clear directional signals, indicating no trend reversal.
Low ADX at 14.6 suggests current movement is more likely a shock-type fluctuation than a trend.
While weekly ADX at 35.4 indicates a strong long-term trend, daily directionality is uncertain.
